entries.name: Flight planning
entries.definition: Preparing a flight by choosing the route, altitude, fuel and alternates from weather, airspace and aircraft performance information.

entries.name: Flipped classroom
entries.definition: A teaching approach in which students meet new material before class, usually by video or reading, and class time is used for practice and discussion.

entries.name: Floating-point arithmetic
entries.definition: How computers represent and calculate with real numbers as a sign, a significand and an exponent, including rounding and precision limits.

entries.name: Fluid statics
entries.definition: The branch of fluid mechanics that studies fluids at rest, including pressure, buoyancy and the forces fluids exert on surfaces.

entries.name: Flutter
entries.definition: Google's open-source toolkit for building natively compiled mobile, web and desktop apps from one codebase, written in the Dart language.

entries.name: Flux analysis
entries.definition: Comparing financial statement figures from one period to another and investigating and explaining the changes.

entries.name: Flux CD
entries.definition: A GitOps tool, part of the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, that keeps Kubernetes clusters in line with configuration stored in Git.

entries.name: Foglight
entries.definition: Quest Software's performance monitoring product for databases, applications and infrastructure.

entries.name: Folk music
entries.definition: Traditional music of a community or region, often passed on by ear, and the styles descended from it.

entries.name: Font Awesome
entries.definition: A toolkit of scalable vector icons, supplied as icon fonts and SVG, that web developers add to sites and apps.

entries.name: Food economics
entries.definition: The study of how food is produced, priced, distributed and consumed, and of the markets and policies around it.

entries.name: Food microbiology
entries.definition: The study of the microorganisms that spoil food, cause foodborne illness or are used to make foods such as cheese and yoghurt.

entries.name: Food palatability evaluation
entries.definition: Judging how acceptable food is to eat in terms of taste, texture, smell and appearance.

entries.name: Food plating and presentation
entries.definition: Arranging and garnishing prepared food on a plate or serving dish so that it looks appealing.

entries.name: Food preservation
entries.definition: Treating or storing food, for example by canning, freezing, drying, salting or pickling, to stop it spoiling.

entries.name: Food process engineering
entries.definition: The branch of engineering that designs and runs the processes and equipment that turn raw agricultural materials into food products.

entries.name: Food procurement
entries.definition: Sourcing, buying and receiving food products for an organisation, including choosing suppliers and negotiating prices.

entries.name: Food safety
entries.definition: Practices for handling, preparing and storing food so that it does not cause illness.

entries.name: Food science
entries.definition: The study of the physical, chemical and biological nature of food and of how it is processed, preserved and made safe.

entries.name: Food systems management
entries.definition: Managing a food service operation, including menu planning, purchasing, production, sanitation and service.

entries.name: Footprinting
entries.definition: The first step of a security assessment, collecting information about a target organisation, its networks and systems to plan later testing.

entries.name: Forced draft systems
entries.definition: Boiler and furnace air systems in which fans push combustion air into the furnace at above atmospheric pressure.

entries.name: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act
entries.definition: A 2010 United States law that requires foreign financial institutions to report accounts held by US taxpayers to the US tax authority.

entries.name: Forensic dentistry
entries.definition: The use of dental knowledge in legal matters, chiefly identifying human remains from dental records and features.

entries.name: Forklift safety
entries.definition: Safe operating and working practices around forklifts, such as load handling, travel rules, inspection and pedestrian safety.

entries.name: Forklift truck
entries.definition: A powered industrial truck with forks at the front for lifting, carrying and stacking pallets and other loads.

entries.name: Framer.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library for building interactive prototypes of user interfaces, originally the engine behind the Framer prototyping tool.

entries.name: Franchise sales
entries.definition: Selling franchise opportunities to prospective franchisees.

entries.name: Fraud prevention and detection
entries.definition: Putting controls in place to stop fraud and analysing transactions and behaviour to spot it when it happens.

entries.name: Fraud risk assessment
entries.definition: A structured review that identifies where and how fraud could occur in an organisation and how likely and damaging it would be.

entries.name: Fraud risk management
entries.definition: Identifying, assessing and controlling the risk of fraud against an organisation.

entries.name: Free body diagrams
entries.definition: Sketches of one body isolated from its surroundings that show every force and moment acting on it, used to solve mechanics problems.

entries.name: Free Lossless Audio Codec
entries.definition: An open, royalty-free format for compressing digital audio without losing any of the original data.

entries.name: Freight handling
entries.definition: Loading, unloading, moving and securing freight at docks, warehouses and terminals.

entries.name: Freight handling equipment
entries.definition: Equipment used to move and load freight, such as forklifts, pallet jacks, conveyors and dock levelers.

entries.name: Freight inspection
entries.definition: Checking shipments for damage, correct count and conformity with shipping documents when they are received or sent.

entries.name: Freshchat
entries.definition: A messaging and live chat product from Freshworks that businesses use to talk with customers.

entries.name: Frisby.js
entries.definition: A Node.js framework for writing tests of REST API endpoints.

entries.name: Frontify
entries.definition: A cloud platform for brand management that stores brand guidelines and assets and shares them across teams.

entries.name: Fuel cell
entries.definition: A device that converts the chemical energy of a fuel, commonly hydrogen, directly into electricity through an electrochemical reaction.
